## Build

- Root `pom.xml` active modules: `app`, `db-utils`; `it-selenium` commented out [verified: pom.xml:51-55]. `assembly-release` has its own pom but is not a module [verified: assembly-release/pom.xml:30, pom.xml:51-55].
- `app` is ONE Maven module split into 8 logical modules by package. `verify_module` runs `mvn -q -pl app -am test -Dtest='<patterns>'`, patterns derived from each module's test paths in `config.yaml` (see the comment there). Note: patterns must NOT start with `**/` (full package path then matches 0 tests) [verified: run in this session].
- Trial run, util-config: 77 tests, BUILD SUCCESS, ~11 s offline [verified: run in this session]. Other modules not run.
- `db-utils`: `mvn -q -pl db-utils -am verify` (~5 s, no tests) [verified: earlier run].
- `verify` (full `mvn -q verify`) is still the final gate.
- app full verify time: ~1m52s wall clock for `mvn -q verify` (whole repo, warm local Maven repo, Derby-backed tests; run this session, no `<failure>`/`<error>` entries in app/target/surefire-reports) [verified: run in this session]

## Modules

Logical modules of `app` [inferred grouping, contents verified]; all are packages under `app/src/{main,test}/java/org/apache/roller`.

| Module | Purpose | Main packages | Context file |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| weblogger-business | Managers, JPA impls, search, pings, themes, startup, tasks | `weblogger/business` | [modules/weblogger-business.md](modules/weblogger-business.md) |
| weblogger-pojos | Domain entities (XML-mapped) + template wrappers | `weblogger/pojos` | [modules/weblogger-pojos.md](modules/weblogger-pojos.md) |
| util-config | Utilities, config access, base exceptions | `util`, `weblogger/{util,config}`, `RollerException`, `WebloggerException` | [modules/util-config.md](modules/util-config.md) |
| ui-core | Filters, listeners, security, UI plugins | `weblogger/ui/{core,tags}` | [modules/ui-core.md](modules/ui-core.md) |
| ui-rendering | Public pages/feeds, Velocity, models, caches | `weblogger/ui/rendering` | [modules/ui-rendering.md](modules/ui-rendering.md) |
| ui-struts2 | Admin/authoring Struts2 UI | `weblogger/ui/struts2` | [modules/ui-struts2.md](modules/ui-struts2.md) |
| webservices | AtomPub, XML-RPC, OpenSearch, TagData | `weblogger/webservices` | [modules/webservices.md](modules/webservices.md) |
| planet | Feed aggregator + weblogger glue | `planet`, `weblogger/planet` | [modules/planet.md](modules/planet.md) |
| db-utils (Maven module) | Jetty listener starting/stopping Derby for local/test runs | n/a | [modules/db-utils.md](modules/db-utils.md) |

Overview of `app` as a whole: [modules/app.md](modules/app.md).

Deliberately NO context: `it-selenium` (disabled in root pom, pom.xml:54) and `assembly-release` (release packaging, not a module). No formatter is expected. `sql/**` is now protected.

## Allowed module dependencies

Directions observed from `import` statements in main code (`grep -o` counts of import lines; last run this session) [verified]:

- `planet` <-> `weblogger` is an ALLOWED cycle: planet -> weblogger 26 import lines (12 files), weblogger -> planet 49 import lines (16 files) [verified: grep count]. In logical modules: `weblogger-business` -> `planet` (15) and `ui-rendering` -> `planet` (12) are the weblogger-side edges; `planet` -> `weblogger-business` (33), `weblogger-pojos` (9), `util-config` (24), `ui-struts2` (1).
- Logical-module edges (A -> B = A imports B), by import-line count:
  - `weblogger-pojos` -> weblogger-business (29), util-config (48), ui-core (1, `pojos/User.java:30`)
  - `weblogger-business` -> weblogger-pojos (212), util-config (~76), planet (15)
  - `util-config` -> weblogger-pojos (25), weblogger-business (8)
  - `ui-core` -> weblogger-business (28), weblogger-pojos (20), util-config (27), ui-rendering (4)
  - `ui-rendering` -> weblogger-pojos (171), weblogger-business (111), util-config (141), ui-core (9), planet (12)
  - `ui-struts2` -> weblogger-pojos (143), weblogger-business (127), util-config (81), ui-core (19), ui-rendering (7)
  - `webservices` -> weblogger-pojos (70), weblogger-business (45), util-config (36), ui-core (4)
  - `planet` -> weblogger-business (33), util-config (24), weblogger-pojos (9), ui-struts2 (1)
- Effective layering (top to bottom): `ui-struts2`, `webservices` -> `ui-rendering` -> `ui-core` -> `weblogger-business` <-> `weblogger-pojos` <-> `util-config`; `planet` hangs off business both ways.
- Nothing imports `webservices`; only `planet` (`PlanetUIAction`) imports `ui-struts2` [verified: grep].
- Known low-level cycles, treated as ALLOWED because they pre-exist and `app` is one compile unit: business <-> pojos, business <-> util-config, pojos <-> util-config, ui-core <-> ui-rendering (`ui/core/filters/LoadSaltFilter` / `SaltValidator` -> `rendering.util.cache.SaltCache`; calendar models -> `rendering.util.WeblogPageRequest`), pojos -> ui-core (`User` -> `RollerContext`).
- NEW edges beyond the lists above (e.g. webservices -> ui-struts2, business -> any ui-*, pojos -> more ui) need approval (`new_cross_module_dependency`). Being one Maven module, the compiler will not catch them; check imports in review.
- `app` -> `db-utils` only as a jetty-maven-plugin dependency [verified: app/pom.xml:636]; `db-utils` -> no in-repo modules [verified: db-utils/pom.xml].
